Messages.Author: Weber Robert John
Messages.Body:
My friends and I have a question about Army of Rats.
What exactly is it? Can it be considered a minion, a location?
It says it can be burned with a D action. Here is where we are confused.
Most other cards say that they can be burned AS a D action, this one
states that it can be burned WITH a D action. So do you need a D action
card to burn it, and if so, what kind of card. If not, can it just be
burned without a card? Please help us out, because we have quite a few
conflicting opinions on this one....

Thanks...

Bob Weber

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
r-w...@ux4.cso.uiuc.edu (Weber Robert John) writes:

>My friends and I have a question about Army of Rats.
>What exactly is it? Can it be considered a minion, a location?

It's a card in play. Nothing more.
If you have an Army of Rats (no matter how many) in play durring your
untap, your prey loses a pool.

>It says it can be burned with a D action. Here is where we are confused.
>Most other cards say that they can be burned AS a D action, this one
>states that it can be burned WITH a D action.

Same thing.

>So do you need a D action
>card to burn it, and if so, what kind of card. If not, can it just be
>burned without a card? Please help us out, because we have quite a few
>conflicting opinions on this one....

You do not need a separate card. The Army gives every minion and additional
option for it's action: "Destroy the Army"

(All from Tom's prior answers, BTW)
L. Scott
